scope: Pinned Playwright browser binaries on Linux only; excludes Edge, real Safari, mobile devices, physical devices, and accessibility certification.

environment.hostCompatibility: Playwright classifies Arch Linux as unsupported and selected its Ubuntu 24.04 fallback builds. WebKit used locally extracted Ubuntu 24.04 libicu74, libxml2, and libflite1 runtime libraries; host-package validation was skipped. No test or browser project was skipped.

browsers.name: webkit
browsers.note: Playwright WebKit; not reported as Safari evidence.

behaviors: page-wide containment and local wide-content scrolling
fixed-header content clearance and reachable controls
mobile navigation focus visibility, containment, Escape dismissal, and restoration
exact clipboard success content and honest denial feedback
JavaScript-disabled content, tabs, image, navigation, and server-rendered code

headlessPlaywrightMcpReview.purpose: Independent rendered-surface check; not part of the maintained acceptance verdict.
headlessPlaywrightMcpReview.observations: All three rendered readable, contained code pages with 16px article insets, zero page-wide overflow, and local auto-scrolling for every wide code block. No overlaps or malformed controls were visible. Success screenshots were inspected and then removed; the harness retains screenshots only for failures.
